name: Avena Spanish Coastal New-Build Market Observations

zenodo_snapshot.note: Earlier one-off snapshot. This dataset version is not deposited on Zenodo.

files.towns.csv: Per-town aggregates of the live book (k>=5): median price, price/m2 quartiles, size, villa share, beach distance
files.movement-ledger.csv: Per observed day: listings observed, price increases/reductions, median move size, delistings, relistings
files.moves.csv: Every individual price move observed (consecutive observations of the same unit)
files.tombstones.csv: Units observed leaving the market: last observed price and date, plus relisted_on and still_listed where the unit was later observed listed again

honesty: Prices are ASKING prices observed in listings. Spanish transaction prices are not public at unit level; nothing here is a registered sale price.
The observation ledger begins 2026-08-05. Earlier internal tables exist but repeated a frozen snapshot rather than recording observations, and are excluded on principle.
A delisting means the unit left the observed feed — strong evidence of absorption, not a notarised sale.

51 of the 346 delisted units were later observed listed again (relisted_on). Of those, 46 are on the market as of the latest observation day (still_listed=true) and are NOT evidence of absorption; the rest returned and left again. 300 of the 346 tombstoned units are absent today. Tombstones are never deleted — a withdrawal followed by a return is itself an observation, and one no public source records.
Cross-sectional aggregates cover only towns with at least 5 live listings.
No listing descriptions, images, URLs, or project/developer names are redistributed — only numeric observations and derived statistics.
AVM accuracy, measured nightly against the whole book, is published at https://avenaterminal.com/model-stats.json (in-sample, caveats included).
